Recommend re-running this company once the search backend is restored, with explicit screening of OFAC SDN/consolidated list, UN, EU, UK OFSI and BIS Entity List, plus Indian Kanoon, NCLT and credit-rating agency lookups. Note also that the claimed legal name in the batch ('HOSEFLEX INDIA PRIVATE LIMITED') differs from the batch name ('Hoseflex India Pvt Ltd') by a transposed letter - this is a legal-identity matter outside my remit, but it should be resolved before any screening is repeated, since a misspelled name would produce false negatives in sanctions and court searches.
